analysis.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price range as it heads to stock market listing
analysis.summary: Anthropic set an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share for its stock market listing, implying a valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion at the top of the range, short of the $2 trillion once expected before investors cooled on the AI boom.
